create_Metadata: create a Metadata object for a given spatial dimension using sparseconvnet.SCN
build_Metadata_3d: build a 3D Metadata object to track active spatial locations at each scale
build_Metadata_2d: build a 2D Metadata object to track active spatial locations at each scale
build_Metadata_4d: build a 4D Metadata object to track active spatial locations at each scale
test_Metadata: test the Metadata function returns a Metadata instance for the specified dimension
